name: Westchester County, NY
findings: Westchester County has 4,468 nonprofit organizations. 1,710 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,446 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Westchester County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 119 arts and cultural organizations here list membership, compared with about 54 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 119 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do arts and cultural organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Westchester County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 1,446 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Westchester County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 593 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
